name: podbay
description: Pod Bay workflow kit: triage findings into tickets, file GitLab issues, run issues end to end into merge requests, explain Rust in MRs. Includes a SessionStart hook that loads the checkout's role file from the team's role map, and a PreToolUse guard (no force-push, no push to main or develop, no merge into main, secret and private-reference scans before GitLab writes).
